sections.shortTitle: The Hyderabad Development Authority Revival and Amending Act 2013
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

THE HYDERABAD DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY
THE HYDERABAD DEVELOPMENT
AUTHORITY
(REVIVAL AND
AMENDING) ACT, 2013
SINDH
ACT NO. LVII OF 2013
KARACHI, THE 19TH DECEMBER, 2013.
AN
ACT
NO.PAS/Legis-B-17/2013--The
Hyderabad Development Authority (Revival and Amending) Bill, 2013 having been
passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 19th
September, 2013 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh
on 27th November, 2013 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh. to revive and amend the law
relating to the Hyderabad Development Authority.
Preamble.-
WHEREAS in order to give impetus and encourage the housing industry and
provide shelter to the people of the Province, it is expedient to revive and
amend the Hyderabad Development Authority Act, 1976, in the manner hereinafter
appearing;
It is hereby
enacted as follows:-
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Act may
be called the Hyderabad Development Authority (Revival and Amending), Act,
2013.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

6. Saving..--All
orders made, proceedings taken, appointments, made, acts done by any authority,
or by any person, which were made, taken or done, or purported to have been
made, taken or done between the first day of July, two thousand two, and the
date on which this Act comes into force (both days inclusive), shall,
notwithstanding any judgment of any court, be deemed to be and always to have
been validly made, taken or done under the Hyderabad Development Authority Act,
1976 and shall not be called in question in any court or forum on any ground
whatsoever.
